C1151.title: European Parliament Opposes Mass Surveillance and Automated Recognition in Policing AI
C1151.summary: In October 2021, the European Parliament opposed mass AI surveillance in policing and called for a permanent ban on automated recognition of individuals in public spaces, predictive policing, and behavioral-data-based citizen scoring. The official position emphasized that law-enforcement AI systems require strict human oversight and must avoid systemic harm to fundamental rights.

references.title: Use of artificial intelligence by the police: MEPs oppose mass surveillance
